## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request title follows Conventional Commits, e.g. `fix(android): ...`.
- [ ] It addresses one issue and contains no unrelated changes or formatting churn.
- [ ] `yarn lint`, `yarn typecheck`, `yarn test` and `yarn example test` pass locally.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated, or I explained why not.
- [ ] Documentation was updated if behavior or the API changed.
- [ ] Native changes cover Android and iOS, or the description says which platform only.
- [ ] If this touches dependencies, `example/`, `android/` or `ios/`: the example app was launched on a device or emulator and its buttons were tapped (CI does not run the app).
- [ ] No face images, templates or other personal data are written to disk, logs or the network.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data are included.
- [ ] New dependencies (if any) are listed below with their licenses.
